title: [narrowed from route-edit-774fbed0] Create the new file repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/consequence-verdict-emit.
description: [narrowed from route-edit-774fbed0] Create the new file repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/consequence-verdict-emit.ts. It exports an async function `emitConsequenceVerdicts` that, for recent substrate-authored executions, derives a keyed consequence verdict and returns an array of shaped `goal_verification_label` impulse bodies. For each execution it takes an input of shape { execution_id: string, commit_sha: string, edit_site: string, changed_symbol?: string }, and computes a verdict object { execution_id, commit_sha, verdict: "STAYED" | "REVERTED" | "RECURRED" | "EXERCISED" | "ABSTAIN", evidence: string }. Rules, applied in order: REVERTED if the commit_sha is not reachable from origin/dev (a confident negative); RECURRED if a later substrate-authored commit edits the same edit_site region (a confident negative, keyed on the site not fuzzy text); EXERCISED if changed_symbol is provided and appears in a later execution trace; otherwise ABSTAIN (absence of evidence is not a negative — never emit a negative verdict on absence). The function must key every verdict on execution_id and must never infer recurrence by fuzzy text similarity. Include a short JSDoc explaining that this is the write half of the consequence-into-credit bridge (the reader in activity-api posterior-update.ts is a separate change) and that ABSTAIN is emitted when evidence is merely absent. Do not wire it into config.ts or impulses.ts in this change; this is the standalone detector module only.
